div.span: REVISION LOOP — up to max_attempts (config.produce.max_attempts, default 3)
no: limit reached — writes last revision, never re-graded

br.span: prompt: article_grade — scores hook / evidence / specificity / voice / cta, weighted (config.produce.grade_weights) → total
prompt: article_revise — rewrites against the grader's own top_fixes

div.span: ce brief select — brief promoted to a piece

br.span: prompt: article_draft — brand voice + evidence_context (git & research citations) + brief angle → first draft
always written either way — sets piece.generated_at (ADR-008)
the one step the system assumes happens — ADR-008's mtime check confirms it later
prompt: claim_extract — reads article.md + evidence_context → classifies each claim
ref must resolve to a real git commit SHA or capture id — including voice-memo transcripts
search + fetch top 3 hits; passes if any source's stance is "supports"
never verified — trusted to claim_extract's own judgment
always fails — couldn't be placed in any other class
written every time, pass or fail — never silently skipped

div.span:
any blocking failure?
grounded/external always block; unverifiable only if block_on_unverifiable is set

br.span: operator reads verification.json, fixes the evidence, or re-runs with --force

span.b: ce assets → ce render → ce package

br.span: renders staged assets, adapts per-platform copy, assembles the review artifact
the human QA gate before anything gets published or posted
